name: mapper
description: Simple one-pager to map both xsl and jq to and from both xml and json

scripts.install-saxon: cd lib/saxon && grep -qF 'productVersion:"2.7"' saxon-js/SaxonJS2.js 2>/dev/null || (wget https://downloads.saxonica.com/SaxonJS/2/SaxonJS-2.7.zip && shasum -c saxon-js.sha1 && unzip -o SaxonJS-2.7.zip && rm SaxonJS-2.7.zip)
scripts.build-production: npm run install-saxon && npm install && webpack --mode=production
